name: Mitake Yuuka
source:
A girl who often wanders around Shinjuku. Underneath her gentle and goddess-like outlook she is a bit shady. For some reason, she dropped out of high school, despite being good at studying.
Due to past events she only trusts the protagonist and often keeps in contact with him.
